recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示皮膚上一大片邊界清楚、浸潤感的紅紫色斑塊，表面有多處潰瘍與黃色痂皮；外觀提示深層皮下病灶，但臨床照片本身無法確診，需切片證實。
features: Large, well-demarcated erythematous to violaceous indurated plaque
Multiple superficial ulcers with yellow fibrinous crusts and hemorrhagic eschar
Faint scaling at the lesional border
No histologic detail available (gross clinical image)
describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a large, well-demarcated erythematous to violaceous indurated plaque with multiple superficial ulcers covered by yellow fibrinous crust and a hemorrhagic eschar, set on hyperpigmented skin. The appearance suggests a deep dermal-subcutaneous inflammatory or infiltrative process. Ulceration is uncommon in subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma and should prompt consideration of gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma or infection. The image is compatible with, but not diagnostic of, subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma; tissue biopsy with immunophenotyping is required.

ddx.vs: Ulcerated and necrotic plaques are more typical of PCGD-TCL, which is separated by TCR-gamma positivity on biopsy.
Lupus profundus heals with lipoatrophy and shows plasma cell–rich lobular panniculitis without atypical CD8+ rimming cells on biopsy.
These show undermined violaceous ulcer borders or organisms on culture, with neutrophilic rather than atypical lymphoid infiltrates histologically.
